intro: 1 bowl of pengat pisang is about 300 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from santan, gula melaka and the bananas.
diet: Yes, you can. But one bowl has about the same calories as a small plate of rice. The santan and gula melaka make it quite dense. Have half a bowl as dessert. Or enjoy a full bowl and cut back on rice or other kuih that day.
tips: Share one bowl with your partner or kids.
If you cook it yourself, mix half santan with half water.
Skip other kuih once you've had pengat.

swap.name: 2 boiled bananas
swap.why: Same banana taste, without the santan and gula melaka.

faq.q: Which bananas are best for pengat?
faq.a: Pisang raja, pisang nangka or pisang tanduk. Pick ones that are ripe but still firm so they don't turn mushy.

faq.q: Why does the santan in my pengat split and turn oily?
faq.a: The fire is too high. Cook on low heat and stir gently.
Yes, on low heat. Add a little water if it's too thick.
